_doc: Agent CLI versions known to break Hollow (repo ideas 2026-10-27 #9), shipped inside Hollow: nothing is fetched. Hollow warns and never blocks: Settings → Accounts → Agent updates flags an installed one, warns before Update installs one (and on the agents.update_cli card), and Automatic doesn't install one by itself. Add an entry when a release breaks Hollow, and remove it when Hollow copes: {"agent": "claude|codex|antigravity|grok", "version": "the exact version its --version prints", "reason": "what breaks, one sentence"}. Schema checked by agent_cli::tests.
